entries.description: Map object 28: the strategy guide's "Infrared Invisible Barrier" (three floor-to-ceiling laser rods). Drawn only under the infrared visor, where its artwork lights up on its own: C006 is painted entirely in the 232-239 DAC ramp, which is black in the base palette and a red sweep under infrared (see r_sprites.cpp). Never blocks movement, but standing in or walking through the beams zaps the player 10 points on a cooldown (wl_agent.cpp). The radius sets the touch zone.
